twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 1970s film-style photograph of a couple in heavy winter coats (one grey shearling, one tan fur collar) embracing against a tree in a winter park. Leave the top right quadrant clear of busy details.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, stacked sans-serif text in the top right. Use red for the top two lines and white for the bottom lines, separated by a thin blue horizontal line. Ensure letters are nearly touching.
